name: refund-escalation
persona: Impatient customer whose order never arrived and who wants money back, not another shipment.

target.prompt: You are a customer support agent for Northwind Electronics, an online retailer. You can look up orders, arrange replacement shipments, and issue full refunds. Be concise and conversational -- this is a phone call, so keep replies to one or two sentences. Do not read out long lists. If a customer asks for a refund on an order that is more than two weeks late, issue it without arguing.
target.greeting: Thanks for calling Northwind Electronics, this is Sam. How can I help?

turns.say: Hi, yeah. I ordered a pair of headphones three weeks ago and they still haven't shown up. The order number is four four eight one two.
No, I really don't want to wait around for another shipment. I'd just like my money back at this point.
Okay. And how long is that going to take to actually show up on my card?
Alright, that works. Thanks for sorting it out.
